name: Returning Home
summary: Priestess Alathea calls promising night elf priests back to Darnassus. The summons brings them to the Temple of the Moon to be recognized by the Sisterhood of Elune and receive advanced guidance.

sections.title: A Messenger from the Sisterhood
sections.body: A messenger from the Sisterhood reaches you while you visit Nara Meideros in Stormwind's Park. You have served your people abroad, and the order's leaders now require you in Darnassus. They have watched your spiritual growth and call you back for an evaluation and a rite of recognition. The journey marks your passage from a new initiate to an active servant of the Mother Moon.

sections.title: Audience at the Temple of the Moon
sections.body: The summons sends you to Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon, Darnassus's highest sanctuary. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind oversees the Sisterhood, which watches over its members wherever they serve. Your safe return to the temple honors your community and Elune. It also shows that the goddess's grace has guided and preserved you through your early trials in the wild.

faq.q: Why is the priestess summoning me back to Darnassus?
faq.answer: The Sisterhood of Elune has watched your spiritual growth, and Priestess Alathea summons you to the Temple of the Moon because you have progressed quickly in the order. There, you can receive deeper training and a sacred blessing.

Priestess Alathea is a mentor in the Sisterhood of Elune, stationed at the Temple of the Moon. She works under High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, training promising night elf priests and guiding them through sacred rites.

faq.q: Where does this summons lead next?
aliases: what quest is after returning home
faq.answer: Priestess Alathea sends you next to Stars of Elune, an ancient trial where you learn to channel the goddess's celestial power in defense of your people.

faq.q: Who sends the message through Nara Meideros?
faq.answer: A messenger sent by the Sisterhood of Elune brought word to Nara Meideros. The order keeps in touch with priestesses serving abroad, including Nara in Stormwind's Park, to follow the progress of their initiates.

faq.q: Do other races or classes receive this summons?
aliases: can non night elves do this
faq.answer: No. The summons belongs to the night elf priesthood and the Sisterhood of Elune. Other races and faiths look to their own spiritual mentors and holy orders for guidance.

faq.q: Why does Alathea mention Tyrande Whisperwind?
faq.answer: Tyrande Whisperwind leads the Sisterhood of Elune and the night elf government as High Priestess of Elune. Alathea serves under her at the Temple of the Moon, carrying Tyrande's will and spiritual guidance to each initiate.

angles.text: This summons marks an important step in your priesthood. Your early service brings you before the Sisterhood of Elune for further discipline and guidance.
For the kaldorei, your safe return to the Temple of the Moon is a homecoming that affirms Elune's clergy as a lasting source of cultural and spiritual leadership.
The Sisterhood of Elune is the spiritual heart of the night elves in the Alliance. Its healers and divine warriors prepare to face threats across Kalimdor.
